questions.stem: How does the hormonal contraceptive pill prevent pregnancy?

options.text: It inhibits FSH so that no eggs mature in the ovaries
It causes the uterus lining to thicken too much for implantation
It kills sperm before they can reach the egg
It creates a physical barrier between sperm and egg

questions.explanation: The contraceptive pill contains hormones (oestrogen and/or progesterone) that inhibit FSH production. Without FSH, no follicles develop and no eggs mature, preventing ovulation.
